body.x: SECOND GROUND is participating in 'CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show)' held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th with the support of Kyungpook University's Smart Venture Business School. BACVING)'BACVING' is a game record commercialization platform that moves sports records from existing manual method to mobile input method. The convenience of the recording was enhanced by using the easy and convenient input terminal of the portable and game type which is advantage of the mobile device.By providing a service that enables users to view individual, team, and league records anytime and anywhere through mobile applications, the information is stored on a web server in real time. The stored information will be analyzed and processed with a unique algorithm, and it will provide a variety of services such as analysis of player ability, prediction of odds according to lineup, and simulation game.Second Ground has confirmed the marketability of the service through contracts with the Korean American Baseball Association and the Korea Athletic Career Association before the official launch of the game, and the official version is expected to be released next February. In addition, it plans to expand its record information service with various sporting events such as tennis, table tennis, and swimming.Meanwhile, CES, the world's largest IT trade show, is held every January as an exhibition sponsored by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA). The global news network, which reported the most issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the past decade, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the global market introduction.→ Go to 'CES 2017' News Special Page
